how_to_apply: Candidates must apply online through their apprenticeship portal login within the notified application window. A general step-by-step process, as reported, is given below; exact portal navigation should be confirmed on the official GACL site.
Log in to the registered apprenticeship portal (National Apprenticeship Training Scheme portal login)
Search for GACL's notified openings under "Baroda" or "Dahej" location
Select the trade/post matching your qualification (ITI/Diploma/Graduate)
Fill in personal, educational, and contact details as required
Upload the necessary documents, including educational certificates and photograph, as prompted by the portal
Submit the application before the closing date (reported as 5 September 2026 - verify on the official portal)
Save/download the confirmation of submission for future reference
important_instructions: Candidates should check the qualification required for their specific trade/post carefully before applying, as eligibility is defined separately for each of the 36 trade/post listings across the two plants Since the official GACL portal could not be independently accessed for this article, candidates are strongly advised to verify all details - including vacancy numbers, stipend, age limit, application fee, and selection process - directly on the official portal before applying Given the date discrepancy noted above, candidates should not wait until late September and should aim to complete their application by 5 September 2026 to be safe

content_sections.heading: GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is defined trade-wise rather than through a single common qualification, since the openings span ITI, Diploma, and Graduate-level apprenticeships together. Broadly, the qualification categories are as follows; candidates should verify the exact requirement for their specific post using the tables above. ITI Trade Apprentices (AOCP, Fitter, Electrician, MMCP, IMCP, LACP, COPA, IM): ITI in the relevant trade through NCVT or GCVT Technician (Diploma) Apprentices: Full-time Diploma in the relevant engineering discipline from a Government-recognized institution Graduate Engineer Apprentices: Full-time B.E./B.Tech in the relevant discipline from a Government-recognized university Apprentice Accountant: Full-time B.Com from a Government-recognized university Apprentice Junior Data Associate: Any Graduate with fluency in computer software

faq.question: Q1. What is GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an apprenticeship engagement drive by Gujarat Alkalies and Chemicals Limited (GACL) for its Baroda and Dahej plants, covering ITI trade, Diploma (Technician), and Graduate Engineer/Commerce apprentice posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified. A total of 18 distinct trade/post categories are listed for the Baroda plant and 18 for the Dahej plant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last Date to apply for GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 is 5 September 2026

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification depends on the trade/post - ranging from ITI certificates (NCVT/GCVT) for trade apprentices to full-time Diploma or B.E./B.Tech/B.Com degrees for Technician, Graduate Engineer, and Accountant apprentice posts. Full post-wise details are listed in the Vacancy section above.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply online for GACL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the GACL apprenticeship portal login, selecting the Baroda or Dahej location and the trade/post matching their qualification, before the application closing date.

faq.question: Q6. At which locations is GACL recruiting apprentices in 2026?
faq.answer: GACL is recruiting apprentices for its plants at Baroda and Dahej in Gujarat.
